missingZipAttachmentIsNotABlocker.why: both evidence sessions hashed the actual installed official source bytes against the freeze's own digest and byte-length pins. The archive is a delivery convenience; the pins are the evidence, and they were checked against real files.

whatTheEvidenceHadToProve.inverted: for these four the evidence proves ABSENCE, not correctness. A court-designated non-filing translation must carry no participant value at all, so a raster of a participant artifact would show the defect survived rather than that it was fixed.
